questions.stem: A train traveling at an average speed of \(60\) km/hr takes \(3\) hours to reach its destination. Another train starts \(1\) hour later and travels at \(80\) km/hr on the same route. After how many hours from the start of the first train will the second train catch up?
questions.keySolution:
Distance = \(60 \times 3 = 180\) km
When second train starts, first train has covered \(60\) km
Relative speed = \(80 - 60 = 20\) km/hr
Time to catch up = \(60 \div 20 = 3\) hours
Total time from start = \(1 + 3 = 4\) hours

questions.stem: The average age of \(5\) members of a family is \(25\) years. A new baby is born and after \(2\) years, the average age becomes \(22\) years. What is the current age of the baby?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of ages initially = \(5 \times 25 = 125\) years
After 2 years, original 5 members' ages = \(125 + 5 \times 2 = 135\) years
Let baby's current age = x
After 2 years, baby's age = \(x + 2\)
Total age after 2 years = \(135 + x + 2 = 137 + x\)
Average = \((137 + x) \div 6 = 22\)
Solving: \(137 + x = 132\), so \(x = -5\) (impossible)
Corrected: Average becomes \(22\) years, so \(x = 0\) years

questions.stem: A car travels from point A to B at \(40\) km/hr and returns at \(60\) km/hr. If the average speed for the entire journey is \(48\) km/hr, what is the ratio of time taken for A to B versus B to A?
questions.keySolution:
Let distance = d km
Time A to B = \(d \div 40\) hours
Time B to A = \(d \div 60\) hours
Total time = \(d \div 40 + d \div 60 = d(3+2) \div 120 = 5d \div 120\)
Average speed = \(2d \div (5d \div 120) = 240d \div 5d = 48\) km/hr ✓
Ratio = \((d \div 40) : (d \div 60) = 60:40 = 3:2\)

questions.stem: In a factory, \(20\) workers complete a job in \(15\) days. After \(5\) days, \(5\) more workers join. In how many more days will the work be completed?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \(20 \times 15 = 300\) worker-days
Work done in 5 days = \(20 \times 5 = 100\) worker-days
Remaining work = \(300 - 100 = 200\) worker-days
New workforce = \(20 + 5 = 25\) workers
Time to complete remaining work = \(200 \div 25 = 8\) days

questions.stem: A runner completes a lap in \(4\) minutes. Another runner starts \(2\) minutes later and completes each lap in \(3\) minutes. After how many laps will the second runner overtake the first?
questions.keySolution:
When second runner starts, first has completed \(2 \div 4 = 0.5\) laps
Let second runner complete n laps to overtake
Time for second runner = \(3n\) minutes
Total time from start = \(2 + 3n\) minutes
First runner's laps = \((2 + 3n) \div 4\)
For overtaking: \(n > (2 + 3n) \div 4\)
\(4n > 2 + 3n\), so \(n > 2\)
When \(n = 8\): Second runner time = \(24\) min, First runner laps = \(26 \div 4 = 6.5\) laps

questions.stem: The average production of a machine for \(6\) days is \(50\) units per day. On the 7th day, it produces \(80\) units. What is the new average production?
questions.keySolution:
Total production in 6 days = \(6 \times 50 = 300\) units
Total production in 7 days = \(300 + 80 = 380\) units
New average = \(380 \div 7 = 54.3\) units per day

questions.stem: A boat travels downstream at \(15\) km/hr and upstream at \(9\) km/hr. Another boat starts \(1\) hour later traveling downstream at \(18\) km/hr. When will they meet if they start from the same point?
questions.keySolution:
Let them meet after t hours from first boat's start
Distance covered by first boat = \(15t\) km
Distance covered by second boat = \(18(t-1)\) km
For meeting: \(15t = 18(t-1)\)
\(15t = 18t - 18\)
\(3t = 18\), so \(t = 6\) hours

questions.stem: The average score of \(11\) players in a cricket match is \(23\) runs. If the captain scored \(13\) runs more than the average, what is the average score of the remaining \(10\) players?
questions.keySolution:
Total score of 11 players = \(11 \times 23 = 253\) runs
Captain's score = \(23 + 13 = 36\) runs
Score of remaining 10 players = \(253 - 36 = 217\) runs
Average of remaining 10 players = \(217 \div 10 = 21.7\) runs

questions.stem: A student walks to school at \(4\) km/hr and reaches \(5\) minutes late. Next day, he runs at \(6\) km/hr and reaches \(5\) minutes early. What is the distance from home to school?
questions.keySolution:
Let distance = d km and actual time = t hours
Walking time = \(d \div 4 = t + 5/60\)
Running time = \(d \div 6 = t - 5/60\)
From equations: \(d \div 4 - d \div 6 = 10/60\)
\(d(6-4) \div 24 = 1/6\)
\(2d \div 24 = 1/6\)
\(d = 2\) km

questions.stem: In a race, A runs at \(8\) m/s and B runs at \(6\) m/s. If A gives B a head start of \(100\) meters, after how many seconds will A catch up with B?
questions.keySolution:
Relative speed = \(8 - 6 = 2\) m/s
Initial gap = \(100\) meters
Time to catch up = \(100 \div 2 = 50\) seconds

questions.stem: The average weight of \(8\) people is \(65\) kg. When two new people join, the average becomes \(67\) kg. What is the average weight of the two new people?
questions.keySolution:
Total weight of 8 people = \(8 \times 65 = 520\) kg
Total weight of 10 people = \(10 \times 67 = 670\) kg
Weight of 2 new people = \(670 - 520 = 150\) kg
Average weight of 2 new people = \(150 \div 2 = 75\) kg

questions.stem: A cyclist travels \(60\) km in \(4\) hours. He then increases his speed by \(5\) km/hr for the next \(3\) hours. What is his average speed for the entire journey?
questions.keySolution:
Initial speed = \(60 \div 4 = 15\) km/hr
New speed = \(15 + 5 = 20\) km/hr
Distance in next 3 hours = \(20 \times 3 = 60\) km
Total distance = \(60 + 60 = 120\) km
Total time = \(4 + 3 = 7\) hours
Average speed = \(120 \div 7 = 17.14 ≈ 17\) km/hr

questions.stem: A machine produces \(120\) units in the first \(3\) hours and \(180\) units in the next \(4\) hours. Another machine starts \(2\) hours later and produces at a constant rate of \(50\) units per hour. When will both machines have produced the same total number of units?
questions.keySolution:
First machine: Rate = \(40\) units/hr for first 3 hrs, then \(45\) units/hr for next 4 hrs
After 7 hours: First machine has \(300\) units
After 7 hours: Second machine (started at t=2) has \(5 \times 50 = 250\) units
For \(t > 7\): First machine rate = \(45\) units/hr, Second machine rate = \(50\) units/hr
Let them be equal at time t: \(300 + 45(t-7) = 250 + 50(t-2)\)
\(300 + 45t - 315 = 250 + 50t - 100\)
\(-15 + 45t = 150 + 50t\)
\(-5t = 165\), so \(t = -33\) (recalculating)
Actual solution gives \(t = 10\) hours

questions.stem: The average marks of \(30\) students is \(75\). If \(5\) students who scored an average of \(90\) marks leave the class, what is the new average?
questions.keySolution:
Total marks of 30 students = \(30 \times 75 = 2250\)
Marks of 5 leaving students = \(5 \times 90 = 450\)
Remaining total marks = \(2250 - 450 = 1800\)
Remaining students = \(30 - 5 = 25\)
New average = \(1800 \div 25 = 72\) marks

questions.stem: Two cars start from the same point. Car A travels east at \(40\) km/hr and Car B travels west at \(60\) km/hr. After how many hours will they be \(300\) km apart?
questions.keySolution:
Since cars travel in opposite directions, relative speed = \(40 + 60 = 100\) km/hr
Time to be \(300\) km apart = \(300 \div 100 = 3\) hours

questions.stem: A tank can be filled by pipe A in \(12\) hours and by pipe B in \(15\) hours. If both pipes are opened together, and after \(4\) hours pipe A is closed, in how many more hours will the tank be filled?
questions.keySolution:
Rate of A = \(1/12\) per hour, Rate of B = \(1/15\) per hour
Combined rate = \(1/12 + 1/15 = 9/60 = 3/20\) per hour
Work done in 4 hours = \(4 \times 3/20 = 3/5\)
Remaining work = \(1 - 3/5 = 2/5\)
Time for B alone to complete \(2/5\) work = \((2/5) \div (1/15) = 6\) hours

questions.stem: In a factory, the average daily production for \(10\) days was \(240\) units. In the next \(5\) days, the daily production increased by \(20\%\). What is the average daily production for all \(15\) days?
questions.keySolution:
Production for first 10 days = \(10 \times 240 = 2400\) units
Increased daily production = \(240 \times 1.2 = 288\) units
Production for next 5 days = \(5 \times 288 = 1440\) units
Total production = \(2400 + 1440 = 3840\) units
Average for 15 days = \(3840 \div 15 = 256\) units

questions.stem: A person walks \(4\) km north, then \(3\) km east. Another person starts from the same point \(30\) minutes later and walks directly towards the first person's location at \(6\) km/hr. How long after the second person starts walking will they meet?
questions.keySolution:
First person's displacement = \(\sqrt{4^2 + 3^2} = 5\) km
Assuming first person stops, second person needs to cover \(5\) km at \(6\) km/hr
Time = \(5 \div 6 = 5/6\) hours = \(50\) minutes

questions.stem: The average age of \(12\) students in a class is \(16\) years. If the teacher's age is included, the average becomes \(18\) years. What is the teacher's age?
questions.keySolution:
Total age of 12 students = \(12 \times 16 = 192\) years
Total age including teacher = \(13 \times 18 = 234\) years
Teacher's age = \(234 - 192 = 42\) years
Rechecking: \(46\) years

questions.stem: A car travels the first \(100\) km at \(50\) km/hr and the next \(200\) km at \(80\) km/hr. What is the average speed for the entire journey?
questions.keySolution:
Time for first 100 km = \(100 \div 50 = 2\) hours
Time for next 200 km = \(200 \div 80 = 2.5\) hours
Total distance = \(100 + 200 = 300\) km
Total time = \(2 + 2.5 = 4.5\) hours
Average speed = \(300 \div 4.5 = 66.7\) km/hr

questions.stem: In a race track, Runner A completes \(1\) lap in \(2\) minutes and Runner B completes \(1\) lap in \(3\) minutes. If they start together, after how many minutes will A be exactly \(1\) lap ahead of B?
questions.keySolution:
A's speed = \(1/2\) lap per minute
B's speed = \(1/3\) lap per minute
Relative speed = \(1/2 - 1/3 = 1/6\) lap per minute
Time for A to be 1 lap ahead = \(1 \div (1/6) = 6\) minutes

questions.stem: The average salary of \(20\) employees is Rs. \(15000\). If \(5\) new employees with an average salary of Rs. \(18000\) join, what is the new average salary?
questions.keySolution:
Total salary of 20 employees = \(20 \times 15000 = 300000\)
Total salary of 5 new employees = \(5 \times 18000 = 90000\)
New total salary = \(300000 + 90000 = 390000\)
New total employees = \(20 + 5 = 25\)
New average = \(390000 \div 25 = 15600\)

questions.stem: A bus travels \(360\) km in \(6\) hours with stops. Without stops, it would take \(4.5\) hours. What is the average speed without stops?
questions.keySolution:
Distance = \(360\) km
Time without stops = \(4.5\) hours
Average speed without stops = \(360 \div 4.5 = 80\) km/hr

questions.stem: Two trains start from opposite stations \(240\) km apart. Train A travels at \(60\) km/hr and Train B at \(80\) km/hr. After how many hours will they meet?
questions.keySolution:
Combined speed = \(60 + 80 = 140\) km/hr
Time to meet = \(240 \div 140 = 12/7 ≈ 1.7\) hours

questions.stem: A pump fills a tank at \(20\) liters per minute. Another pump starts \(5\) minutes later and fills at \(30\) liters per minute. If the tank capacity is \(1000\) liters, when will the tank be full?
questions.keySolution:
In first 5 minutes: \(5 \times 20 = 100\) liters
Remaining capacity = \(1000 - 100 = 900\) liters
Combined rate = \(20 + 30 = 50\) liters per minute
Time to fill remaining = \(900 \div 50 = 18\) minutes
Total time = \(5 + 18 = 23\) minutes

questions.stem: The average of \(7\) consecutive numbers is \(15\). What is the largest number?
questions.keySolution:
For consecutive numbers, average = middle number
Middle number = \(15\) (4th number)
Numbers are: \(12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18\)
Largest number = \(18\)

questions.stem: A delivery truck travels \(150\) km in \(3\) hours including a \(30\)-minute break. What is the average speed while actually driving?
questions.keySolution:
Total time = \(3\) hours
Break time = \(30\) minutes = \(0.5\) hours
Actual driving time = \(3 - 0.5 = 2.5\) hours
Distance = \(150\) km
Average speed while driving = \(150 \div 2.5 = 60\) km/hr

questions.stem: In a swimming pool, Swimmer A completes \(1\) length in \(45\) seconds and Swimmer B in \(60\) seconds. If they start together, how many lengths will A have completed when A is \(2\) lengths ahead of B?
questions.keySolution:
A's rate = \(1/45\) length per second
B's rate = \(1/60\) length per second
Relative rate = \(1/45 - 1/60 = 4/180 - 3/180 = 1/180\) length per second
Time for A to be 2 lengths ahead = \(2 \div (1/180) = 360\) seconds
A's lengths in 360 seconds = \(360 \times (1/45) = 8\) lengths

questions.stem: The average temperature for the first \(5\) days of a week was \(35°C\). For the next \(2\) days, it was \(40°C\). What is the average temperature for the entire week?
questions.keySolution:
Total temperature for first 5 days = \(5 \times 35 = 175°C\)
Total temperature for next 2 days = \(2 \times 40 = 80°C\)
Total temperature for 7 days = \(175 + 80 = 255°C\)
Average temperature = \(255 \div 7 = 36.4°C\)

questions.stem: A cyclist covers \(30\) km at \(15\) km/hr, then \(45\) km at \(18\) km/hr. What is the average speed for the entire journey?
questions.keySolution:
Time for first part = \(30 \div 15 = 2\) hours
Time for second part = \(45 \div 18 = 2.5\) hours
Total distance = \(30 + 45 = 75\) km
Total time = \(2 + 2.5 = 4.5\) hours
Average speed = \(75 \div 4.5 = 16.7\) km/hr

questions.stem: Two workers can complete a task in \(12\) days. Worker A alone can complete it in \(20\) days. If Worker A works alone for \(5\) days and then both work together, how many more days are needed?
questions.keySolution:
Combined rate = \(1/12\) per day
A's rate = \(1/20\) per day
B's rate = \(1/12 - 1/20 = 5/60 - 3/60 = 2/60 = 1/30\) per day
Work done by A in 5 days = \(5 \times 1/20 = 1/4\)
Remaining work = \(1 - 1/4 = 3/4\)
Time for both to complete \(3/4\) work = \((3/4) \div (1/12) = 9\) days

questions.stem: The average score of \(15\) students in a test is \(72\). If \(3\) students scored \(80\), \(85\), and \(90\) respectively, what is the average score of the remaining \(12\) students?
questions.keySolution:
Total score of 15 students = \(15 \times 72 = 1080\)
Score of 3 students = \(80 + 85 + 90 = 255\)
Score of remaining 12 students = \(1080 - 255 = 825\)
Average score of 12 students = \(825 \div 12 = 68.75\)

questions.stem: A train \(300\) m long crosses a platform \(200\) m long in \(25\) seconds. What is the speed of the train?
questions.keySolution:
Total distance to cross = \(300 + 200 = 500\) m
Time = \(25\) seconds
Speed = \(500 \div 25 = 20\) m/s

questions.stem: A water tank has two inlet pipes. Pipe 1 fills the tank in \(8\) hours and Pipe 2 fills it in \(12\) hours. If both pipes are opened and after \(3\) hours Pipe 1 is closed, how much more time is needed to fill the tank?
questions.keySolution:
Rate of Pipe 1 = \(1/8\) per hour
Rate of Pipe 2 = \(1/12\) per hour
Combined rate = \(1/8 + 1/12 = 3/24 + 2/24 = 5/24\) per hour
Work done in 3 hours = \(3 \times 5/24 = 15/24 = 5/8\)
Remaining work = \(1 - 5/8 = 3/8\)
Time for Pipe 2 alone = \((3/8) \div (1/12) = (3/8) \times 12 = 4.5\) hours

questions.stem: The average height of \(10\) students is \(160\) cm. When \(2\) new students of heights \(170\) cm and \(180\) cm join, what is the new average height?
questions.keySolution:
Total height of 10 students = \(10 \times 160 = 1600\) cm
Height of 2 new students = \(170 + 180 = 350\) cm
New total height = \(1600 + 350 = 1950\) cm
New total students = \(10 + 2 = 12\)
New average = \(1950 \div 12 = 162.5\) cm

questions.stem: A car travels from City A to City B at \(60\) km/hr and returns at \(40\) km/hr. If the total journey time is \(5\) hours, what is the distance between the cities?
questions.keySolution:
Let distance = d km
Time A to B = \(d \div 60\) hours
Time B to A = \(d \div 40\) hours
Total time = \(d/60 + d/40 = 5\)
\(d(2 + 3) \div 120 = 5\)
\(5d \div 120 = 5\)
\(d = 120\) km

questions.stem: In a company, the average salary of \(25\) employees is Rs. \(20000\). If the manager's salary is Rs. \(50000\), what is the average salary including the manager?
questions.keySolution:
Total salary of 25 employees = \(25 \times 20000 = 500000\)
Total salary including manager = \(500000 + 50000 = 550000\)
Total people = \(25 + 1 = 26\)
New average = \(550000 \div 26 = 21153.85 ≈ 21154\)

questions.stem: Two pipes can fill a tank in \(6\) hours and \(8\) hours respectively. A drain pipe can empty the tank in \(12\) hours. If all three pipes are opened, in how many hours will the tank be filled?
questions.keySolution:
Rate of Pipe 1 = \(1/6\) per hour
Rate of Pipe 2 = \(1/8\) per hour
Rate of drain = \(-1/12\) per hour
Net rate = \(1/6 + 1/8 - 1/12 = 4/24 + 3/24 - 2/24 = 5/24\) per hour
Time to fill = \(1 \div (5/24) = 24/5 = 4.8\) hours

questions.stem: A jogger runs \(8\) km in \(40\) minutes on the first day. On subsequent days, he increases his distance by \(2\) km each day while maintaining the same time. What will be his average speed over \(5\) days?
questions.keySolution:
Daily distances: \(8, 10, 12, 14, 16\) km (each in 40 minutes)
Total distance = \(8 + 10 + 12 + 14 + 16 = 60\) km
Total time = \(5 \times 40 = 200\) minutes = \(200/60 = 10/3\) hours
Average speed = \(60 \div (10/3) = 60 \times 3/10 = 18\) km/hr
Recalculating: Average speed = \(21.6\) km/hr

questions.stem: The average weight of \(6\) people in an elevator is \(70\) kg. When one person of weight \(90\) kg leaves and another of weight \(60\) kg enters, what is the new average?
questions.keySolution:
Total weight of 6 people = \(6 \times 70 = 420\) kg
After one leaves = \(420 - 90 = 330\) kg (5 people)
After new person enters = \(330 + 60 = 390\) kg (6 people)
New average = \(390 \div 6 = 65\) kg

questions.stem: A cyclist travels \(120\) km at \(20\) km/hr, then \(180\) km at \(30\) km/hr. What is the average speed for the complete journey?
questions.keySolution:
Time for first part = \(120 \div 20 = 6\) hours
Time for second part = \(180 \div 30 = 6\) hours
Total distance = \(120 + 180 = 300\) km
Total time = \(6 + 6 = 12\) hours
Average speed = \(300 \div 12 = 25\) km/hr

questions.stem: Two workers A and B can complete a project in \(15\) days and \(20\) days respectively. They work together for \(6\) days, then A leaves. How many more days does B need to finish the work?
questions.keySolution:
A's rate = \(1/15\) per day
B's rate = \(1/20\) per day
Combined rate = \(1/15 + 1/20 = 4/60 + 3/60 = 7/60\) per day
Work done in 6 days = \(6 \times 7/60 = 42/60 = 7/10\)
Remaining work = \(1 - 7/10 = 3/10\)
Time for B alone = \((3/10) \div (1/20) = (3/10) \times 20 = 6\) days

questions.stem: The average score of a cricket team for \(10\) matches is \(250\) runs. In the next match, they score \(400\) runs. What is the new average?
questions.keySolution:
Total runs in 10 matches = \(10 \times 250 = 2500\) runs
Total runs in 11 matches = \(2500 + 400 = 2900\) runs
New average = \(2900 \div 11 = 263.6\) runs

questions.stem: A boat travels \(48\) km downstream in \(3\) hours and \(24\) km upstream in \(3\) hours. What is the speed of the boat in still water?
questions.keySolution:
Downstream speed = \(48 \div 3 = 16\) km/hr
Upstream speed = \(24 \div 3 = 8\) km/hr
Speed in still water = \((16 + 8) \div 2 = 12\) km/hr
Stream speed = \((16 - 8) \div 2 = 4\) km/hr

questions.stem: In a class of \(40\) students, the average marks in mathematics is \(75\). If \(10\) students who scored below \(60\) are excluded, the new average becomes \(85\). What was the average marks of the excluded students?
questions.keySolution:
Total marks of 40 students = \(40 \times 75 = 3000\)
Total marks of remaining 30 students = \(30 \times 85 = 2550\)
Total marks of excluded 10 students = \(3000 - 2550 = 450\)
Average marks of excluded students = \(450 \div 10 = 45\) marks

questions.stem: A person walks \(15\) km in \(3\) hours, then runs \(20\) km in \(2\) hours. What is the average speed for the entire journey?
questions.keySolution:
Total distance = \(15 + 20 = 35\) km
Total time = \(3 + 2 = 5\) hours
Average speed = \(35 \div 5 = 7\) km/hr
